historical_reconciliation.reservation: The protected #3086 child freezes the authorization/reservation boundary with no genuine production requester/claimant adapter. This subordinate child supplies those implementations and operation-scoped retained authorization evidence without rewriting the protected reservation contract or changing rpa_ identity and store semantics.
historical_reconciliation.independent_issuer: Retain genuine pre-account requester and claimant ownership, exact entitlement claimant provenance, role non-aliasing and ACTIVE-only authorization; signature creation, issuer decisions and root proof remain downstream.
historical_reconciliation.implementation_readiness: Protected NOT_AVAILABLE discovery and BLOCKED implementation snapshots remain historical. IMPLEMENTED public credential providers are distinct from actual installed production credentials and do not satisfy the complete issuer implementation gate.
historical_reconciliation.production_selection: Implement the selected separate PostgreSQL schema/API/DB role for each credential registry. Keep semantic PRODUCTION distinct from provider security profile PRODUCTION_LOCAL. No SQLite, CHA attempt store, entitlement table or JSON credential authority is selected.

substrate_source.minimal_port_extension: public_key(credential_identity: str) -> bytes on both verifier-side registry ports; this is not a signing-provider port and grants no private-key custody

postgresql.low_level_installer_identifiers: Explicit safe parameterized identifiers for independently reviewed installations and isolated PostgreSQL tests; public installed Stage 9 selection is fixed to the requester/claimant profile below

role_authentication.SECURITY_DEFINER_owner_execution: Supported with NOLOGIN; offline bootstrap installation uses SET LOCAL ROLE owner
role_authentication.owner_trust_assumption: Schema owner remains a full trusted mutation authority when activated by privileged bootstrap or superuser and can bypass the admin API; NOLOGIN removes direct authentication only

runtime.DDL_scope: Persistent database schemas and credential-authority objects

temporary_workspace.authority_lookup: Pinned pg_catalog search_path and fully qualified authority tables prevent temporary-workspace shadowing

admin.required_role: exact separate registry admin DB role
admin.mutation_fence: expected_revision equals target credential latest retained revision

postgresql.PUBLIC_privileges_scope: Reviewed credential-authority schemas, tables and functions; database TEMP grants are outside this scope
postgresql.authority_transactions: PostgreSQL SERIALIZABLE; durable atomic credential/history/current changes
postgresql.peer_material_lookup: Schema-owner SELECT of the peer immutable public credential table solely for requester/claimant non-alias validation; runtime/admin cross-role privilege grants are forbidden

requester.historical_credential_resolution: Retained exact key identity and latest authenticated lifecycle record for that credential; no destructive public-key overwrite

canonical_public_key.credential_identity: exact retained credential_id or key_id; ambiguity rejects; #3086 role evidence uses exact key_id; immutable key material for that identity

lifecycle_and_history.VERIFY_ONLY: Historical verification/recovery only; never new issuance authorization
lifecycle_and_history.REVOKED: No new operation; historical signature alone establishes no retained trust
lifecycle_and_history.key_version: Monotonic per-principal key rotation version; unchanged during lifecycle-only transitions
lifecycle_and_history.lifecycle_generation: Monotonic per-principal append generation; rotation appends retired old lifecycle and new ACTIVE generation
lifecycle_and_history.registry_revision: Authoritative append revision included in #3086 exact live evidence
lifecycle_and_history.history_model: Append-only immutable credential rows and lifecycle history with canonical current projection
lifecycle_and_history.current_projection: Exact latest lifecycle record for the current highest-version credential; may precede principal history head when a historical credential is revoked
lifecycle_and_history.historical_credential_transition: Optional exact credential_id targets retained key; VERIFY_ONLY -> REVOKED preserves current replacement ACTIVE pointer and all old public material
lifecycle_and_history.history_authority: PostgreSQL authenticated DB roles and reviewed authority APIs; no caller-owned DTO, process mutex or fingerprint grants authority
lifecycle_and_history.rotation: Retain old exact public key and history; move old ACTIVE to VERIFY_ONLY and publish exactly one new ACTIVE winner atomically

production_composition.entitlement_required: ACTIVE + UNBOUND with exact claimant principal/key/version provenance
production_composition.allowlist: Only the exact reviewed genuine aggregate type; arbitrary subclasses/plugins/duck types rejected
production_composition.selector: Exact existing entitlement lookup handle; claimant derived only from authoritative entitlement provenance

authorization_evidence.entitlement: Exact resolved authoritative state including generation, revision and claimant provenance
authorization_evidence.requester_and_claimant: Exact ACTIVE DTOs for the fixed requester and entitlement-provenance claimant only
authorization_evidence.resolved_credential_identity: Exactly one selected CredentialRoleIdentity matching resolved key ID, semantic role, provider namespace, key version, ACTIVE lifecycle generation and exact registry revision
authorization_evidence.public_key_material_identity: Recomputed from each resolved credential's authoritative exact raw Ed25519 public key
unrelated_claimant_mutations: revoke another principal's retained historical credential
authorization_evidence.same_exact_operation_evidence: Same authorization_evidence_sha256 and same existing rpa_ after re-require, load or reserve
authorization_evidence.relevant_changes: Exact INITIAL_BINDING, entitlement state/generation/revision, resolved ACTIVE requester or claimant, selected credential/material identity, or provider identity/capabilities/security/trust change invalidates the operation capability
global_qualification_outside_hash: Full requester and claimant current/historically relevant credential_identities() populations
Provider structure and canonical credential semantic-role/namespace evidence
Global forbidden cross-role public-key material aliases
Exact live PostgreSQL schema/version/owner/runtime/admin role and ACL evidence
authorization_evidence.global_qualification_failure: FAIL_CLOSED even when operation-scoped evidence is unchanged
authorization_evidence.second_resolution_pass: Requalify global live populations; compare exact provider identity/capabilities and selected operation credential evidence, not unrelated credential population equality

production_composition.changed_revision_lifecycle_key_provider_: Exact operation-scoped evidence change invalidates capability and fails closed; unrelated principal changes do not change operation identity

atomicity.credential_insert_history_append_current: one SERIALIZABLE transaction; fault rolls back all changes
atomicity.rotation_and_lifecycle: expected latest target credential revision + locked canonical current state + immutable append; stale target revision rejects
atomicity.concurrent_first_provisioning: one current ACTIVE winner; same exact retry idempotent; conflicting identity/material rejects
atomicity.concurrent_rotation: one authoritative replacement wins; no two ACTIVE generations
atomicity.concurrent_transition: one authoritative successor; stale generation rejects
atomicity.restart: Consistent retained history/current pointer; old keys and VERIFY_ONLY/REVOKED evidence survive reconnect
